# Auth: Google sign-up and sign-in

Generated by `skies g auth:oauth`. The dev `IExternalIdentityVerifier` (`FakeExternalIdentity`) treats a non-empty
token as a verified identity whose email is the token and rejects an empty one, so the cases in `e2e/` exercise the
same bypass guard a real verifier sits behind.

## Behavior

- `POST /account/register/google` verifies the identity token and creates an email-verified account (no usable
  password, registration at PhonePending), then opens a session.
- `POST /account/login/google` verifies the token, finds the account by its email across orgs, and opens a session.

## Failure modes

- FM-1 A verified Google identity does not create an email-verified account with a live session
- FM-2 An unverifiable token creates an account or a session
- FM-3 A Google identity whose email already has an account creates a second one
- FM-4 A Google identity with an account cannot sign in
- FM-5 An unverifiable token signs in
- FM-6 A verified Google identity without an account signs in
- FM-7 A request with no id token fails as a server error instead of being denied like a forged token

## Out of scope

- Real Google token validation: register an `OidcIdTokenVerifier` (or another `IExternalIdentityVerifier`) in
  `AccountModule`.
- Linking a Google identity to an existing password account.
